findings.claim: Q3 2026 (reported 2026-10-29): total net sales $6,263M +12%, organic +15%. Climate Solutions Americas $3,354M +24% (organic +25%); Europe $1,335M +3% (organic +12%, offset by divestiture/FX); AMEA $848M +2% (organic +3%); Transportation $726M -3%. Riello and NORESCO divestitures reduced revenue.
findings.source: Carrier Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results (carrier.com) / 8-K ex99

findings.claim: Q2 2026 call transcript summary: orders up ~40%, commercial HVAC orders +65%, data-center orders up fourfold, backlog >$8B, full-year data center sales outlook raised to ~$2B (secondary summary, unverified against primary).
findings.source: MarketBeat Carrier Global Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

findings.claim: Pricing actions of about 2% for FY2026, roughly three-quarters tariff-related (aggregator summary of Q1 2026 results); Q2 adjusted operating margin down 190bp to 17.2% as mix and input costs outran pricing (MarketBeat per search summary). No direct market share data found.
Commercial sales in Americas expected to exceed residential within next couple of years; residential price increases remain part of outlook
